using System;
using System.IO;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Model
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The server application paths.
    /// </summary>
    public class ServerApplicationPaths : IApplicationPaths
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="ServerApplicationPaths"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="programDataPath">The program data path.</param>
        /// <param name="logDirectoryPath">The log directory path.</param>
        /// <param name="configurationDirectoryPath">The configuration directory path.</param>
        /// <param name="cachePath">The cache path.</param>
        /// <param name="webPath">The web path.</param>
        public ServerApplicationPaths(string programDataPath, string logDirectoryPath, string configurationDirectoryPath, string cachePath, string webPath)
        {
            ProgramDataPath = programDataPath;
            LogDirectoryPath = logDirectoryPath;
            ConfigurationDirectoryPath = configurationDirectoryPath;
            CachePath = cachePath;
            WebPath = webPath;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the program data path.
        /// </summary>
        public string ProgramDataPath { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the log directory path.
        /// </summary>
        public string LogDirectoryPath { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the configuration directory path.
        /// </summary>
        public string ConfigurationDirectoryPath { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the cache path.
        /// </summary>
        public string CachePath { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the web path.
        /// </summary>
        public string WebPath { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the temp directory.
        /// </summary>
        public string TempDirectory => Path.GetTempPath();

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the program system path.
        /// </summary>
        public string ProgramSystemPath => AppContext.BaseDirectory;
    }
}

using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Jellyfin.Server.Helpers;
using Jellyfin.Server.Model;

public class StartupHelpersTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void LogEnvironmentInfo_LogsEnvironmentVariables()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
        var appPaths = new ServerApplicationPaths("programDataPath", "logDirectoryPath", "configurationDirectoryPath", "cachePath", "webPath");

        // Act
        StartupHelpers.LogEnvironmentInfo(loggerMock.Object, appPaths);

        // Assert
        loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogInformation(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object>()), Times.AtLeastOnce);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CreateApplicationPaths_CreatesPaths()
    {
        // Arrange
        var options = new StartupOptions();

        // Act
        var appPaths = StartupHelpers.CreateApplicationPaths(options);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(appPaths);
        Assert.NotNull(appPaths.ProgramDataPath);
        Assert.NotNull(appPaths.LogDirectoryPath);
        Assert.NotNull(appPaths.ConfigurationDirectoryPath);
        Assert.NotNull(appPaths.CachePath);
        Assert.NotNull(appPaths.WebPath);
    }
}
